teaching_clarity.rationale: The full-resolution master makes the allocation puzzle, scalar failure, contestability record, decision lease, rights receipt, standing repair, finite evidence boundary, and objective handoff legible as a single causal story without claiming that the procedure resolves moral disagreement.

composition.rationale: The 16:9 frame uses stable spatial roles for active resource, destinations, records, custody, dissent, and open evidence. The 30 beat end/middle/start samples and full-resolution caption sheet show no clipped labels or competing focal points.

motion_quality.rationale: The 188 animation events are purposeful transitions: routes, record construction, fail-closed stops, custody separation, receipt travel, requalification, and handoff. Mechanical freeze intervals are intentional reading holds with narrated content and explicit pedagogical purpose.

synchronization.rationale: Thirty exact audio receipt boundaries, 401.895 seconds of video and audio, 90 caption cues, and the final mux agree. The plan audit passes semantic/story coverage; the AV audit reports matching duration, no black frames, no silence, and stable loudness.

continuity.rationale: The gold generator and lease, green clinic, violet homes, blue receipt, red boundary, dissent, and next-review clock recur with stable meaning from hook through worked trace and final callback.

pacing.rationale: The 913-word narration runs at 136.3 words per minute. The 06:41.90 runtime intentionally exceeds the preferred soft range because the case must keep value plurality, standing repair, rights/exit/fork duties, evidence lanes, and handoff separate; it is not compressed by speeding speech.

voice.rationale: The locked narration is warm around the two neighborhoods and precise at leases, rights, custody, and nonclaims. It distinguishes a bounded authorization from a moral, legal, institutional, or deployment conclusion.

sound_mix.rationale: The final master is 48 kilohertz mono AAC and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.1 LU range, and minus 1.3 dBTP with no detected silence or clipping.

engagement.rationale: The opening scarce-resource dilemma, scalar temptation, missing-standing stop, repair, narrow four-hour lease, receipt custody, replacement reopening, and unresolved handoff sustain a clear arc while preserving contestability.

accessibility.rationale: Color is duplicated by labels, position, enclosure, arrows, and line style. All 90 captions pass exact receipt timing and representative-frame review; the generation-2 descriptive transcript names every material visual transition; the 1280×720 thumbnail remains legible at reduced size.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The film explicitly remains a design rationale and synthetic finite case at argument support. It refuses to establish moral truth, legal rights, consensus, fair deployment, independent review quality, safe export or fork, institutional adequacy, or any empirical, safety, AGI, or ASI result.

non_claim: Passing picture-and-sound lock records final geometry, narration, captions, transcript, thumbnail, timing, and experience review only; release-candidate, independent release-candidate, publication, and book-evidence promotion remain ungranted. Rejected and superseded renders remain preserved as generation history.
